intro: From April to September 2026, ZCyberNews covered 16 open-source articles, spanning a global impact across technology, research, software development, enterprise applications, and financial services. Reporting highlighted critical vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-25874 (CVSS 9.3), CVE-2026-33626 (CVSS 7.5), CVE-2026-8114 (CVSS 6.5), and CVE-2026-42286. Coverage detailed a severity mix of four medium, four critical, two high, and five informational findings, reflecting the broad risk landscape within open-source ecosystems.
